narrative:
Compared to the last report, hay movement has been slow, most producers out in Western Nevada are sold out of small bales and some Central Nevada producers are sold out for the season with contracts sending their hay to California dairies. There is quite a few producers holding onto their hay for prices to change or for the demand to grow. Small bales going to stables have a good demand all over the state. 

According to the U.S. Drought Monitor Website; 53.49% of the state is in a moderate drought or worse, 11.20% of the state is in severe drought or worse, 1.89% of the state is in extreme drought or worse.
